options.name: Chant
options.benefit: Extend the duration of the evil eye, fortune, fury, and misfortune hexes.

options.name: Charm
options.benefit: Improve a creature's attitude for a limited duration.

options.name: Evil Eye
options.benefit: Penalise one category of the target's rolls.

options.name: Fetish
options.benefit: Gain a bonus item-creation feat and use Wisdom for its prerequisites.

options.name: Fortune
options.benefit: Let an ally reroll one d20 roll each round.

options.name: Healing
options.benefit: Heal a creature once per day as cure light wounds, scaling at level 5.

options.name: Misfortune
options.benefit: Force a creature to roll twice and take the worse result.

options.name: Secret
options.benefit: Gain a metamagic feat and use Wisdom for its prerequisites.

options.name: Shapeshift
options.benefit: Assume an animal form for a number of hours each day.

options.name: Silkstring Snare
options.benefit: Create magical traps from cord, hair, or rope.

options.name: Ward
options.benefit: Grant a creature a deflection AC and resistance-save bonus.
